ABOUT

A little about me

I am a Mechanical and Industrial Engineer interested in turning engineering challenges into practical and reliable solutions.

My background

I am a Colombian engineer currently based in Luxembourg, with a background in Mechanical and Industrial Engineering and a passion for creating practical solutions to engineering challenges.

My experience ranges from medical engineering and manufacturing to robotics and automation. I enjoy working across disciplines, combining mechanical design, electronics and software to turn ideas into functional systems.

I am currently pursuing a Master's degree in Space Technologies and Business at the University of Luxembourg, while contributing to robotics research at the SpaceR Research Group.

Curious by nature and always eager to learn, I enjoy taking on new challenges, exploring new technologies and turning knowledge into real-world applications.
